name: Pro AG Equipment
old_description: Founded in 1948 as Lockwood Corp. grand forks and transitioning to Pro Ag Equipment 1982.
about:
Pro AG Equipment traces its roots to 1948 when Lockwood Corp. was established in Grand Forks, North Dakota. The business transitioned to its current name, Pro Ag Equipment, in 1982. Headquartered in Grafton, North Dakota, the company operates three locations: Grand Forks and Grafton in North Dakota, and Hastings in Florida. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company functions primarily as a distributor of short-line equipment tailored for sugar beet, bean, and potato farming. Beyond new equipment sales, Pro Ag Equipment supplies parts, liquid fertilizer components, and provides repair services. It also performs manufacturing, though the scope of in-house production is not detailed. The multi-location footprint supports a regional supply chain for agricultural operators.

Pro Ag Equipment serves growers and agricultural operations specializing in sugar beet, bean, and potato production. Its customer base includes farms and dealers requiring equipment, replacement parts, fertilizer system components, and maintenance support. The company's geographic presence in the Red River Valley and Florida positions it to serve major sugar beet and potato growing regions.

The company highlights a special annual service sale as a recurring customer benefit. Its longevity since 1948 and evolution from Lockwood Corp. reflect a focus on adapting to the equipment needs of specialty crop farmers.
